name: Live Collab
description: Work on the same note with other people at the same time, like Google Docs: you see their cursors and selections with their names, and their typing appears as they type. Type // and choose “Live session” to make an invite, send it to a friend, and both of you choose “Go live with this note” from the note's ⋯ menu. It needs a small relay server that you run yourself (see the README).
author: Granite
